dedupe_keys.name: data gouv fr cycling and walking datasets

description: data.gouv.fr: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by data.gouv.fr. The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Pistes cyclables (OpenStreetMap); Pistes cyclables (Ville de Montpellier); Locations de vélos (OSM); Pistes et bandes cyclables (OSM). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
